spec_digest.sets: CAT = frozen catalogue; S = CAT minus default; 'other' and 'invalid' are separate columns and 'other' never counts as a landing; CORRECT = passes every hidden test within its per-case limit
spec_digest.DEFAULT: modal CORRECT label over the 300 twin samples (T 1.0 and T 1.3 pooled) with share >= 0.6 among correct programs, else NO_DEFAULT (CHOICE: pooled 300; the T 1.0-only default reported beside and flagged if different); NO_DEFAULT units enter no L or M test
spec_digest.TWIN_BASELINE_for_gates: the T 1.0 twin (50 HF CRN slots + 150 vLLM slots if the unit passed the engine check, else the 50 HF slots): twin_pass and twin_off = correct S-labelled / all
spec_digest.q_tail: add-one smoothed counts over S + {other} of the correct non-default programs among the 300 twin samples; t_u = argmax over S (tie: higher T 1.0 count, then catalogue order); TAIL_EMPTY = no correct S program among the 300
spec_digest.q_lik: 10 name-scrubbed, test-passing forced programs per algorithm whose runtime/final label equals the algorithm (comments + docstrings removed first); tokens = chat_template(twin prompt w) + '```python\n' + program; lp = sum log-softmax(fp32 logits) over the first 48 program tokens; score_raw = mean lp, score_tok = mean lp / n_tokens; q_lik = softmax over S of score_tok; q_lik_raw = softmax over S of score_raw; qlik_top1 = argmax over S of score_tok; unscrubbed sensitivity; noise floor = median |delta lp| of 20 programs re-scored in another batch composition; fixed batch shapes, left padding with attention mask
spec_digest.fork_margin: m = mean lp(default) - mean lp(r_u) (raw; per-token version beside)
spec_digest.q_base: counts of CORRECT base programs over CAT + {other} from 200 chat-template samples (identical token ids to the twin W1-W5 prompts) + 100 plain completions; < 20 correct -> valid attempts, flag LOW_CORRECT; add-one smoothing over S + {other} for forecasting; r_u = argmax over S (tie: higher plain count, then catalogue order); DISCORDANT = r_u != qlik_top1; beta = 1 - base_correct(default) / base_correct_total
spec_digest.forecasts_for_scoring: every forecast restricted to S and renormalised ('other' dropped), identically for q_base, q_tail, q_lik, association and uniform = 1/(K-1)
spec_digest.CELL: one (arm, alpha, direction); QUALIFIES iff pass_rate >= 0.8 x twin_pass
spec_digest.ESCAPE: share = correct S-labelled programs / all programs in the cell; stage 1 (N 10): share >= twin_off + 0.20 and qualifies; stage 2: +20 slots (2-5 per template), CONFIRMED iff the pooled 30 has one-sided exact binomial p < 0.05 vs p0 = (k_twin + 0.5)/(n_twin + 1) and still qualifies; E_u(alpha) = confirmed / 8; E_u = mean over the alphas run
spec_digest.LANDING_EVENT: one (unit, nudge type), nudge in {ESC, PN, GTN} (content_free) or BINT (content_free = false: K and descriptive tables only); pool correct S-labelled programs over the nudge type's QUALIFYING cells (every ESC cell at N 10 or 30; PN alpha 2 and 4; GTN alpha 2); is_event iff pooled count >= 5; modal_landing = argmax over S if its share of the pooled S-labelled correct programs leads the next by >= 15 points, else NO_CLEAR_LANDING (a miss for every top-1 forecast); pooled correct 'other' reported, flag other_dominant if it exceeds the modal count
spec_digest.SETS: CONFIRMATION = new list-II units; SCREEN = the 15 iteration-5 units

tests.L1a: Ea = tail-empty events; hits = [r_u == modal_landing]; exact Poisson-binomial P(X >= hits) with per-event chance 1/(K_e - 1); PASS iff |Ea| >= 6, hits/|Ea| >= 2/3, p < 0.05; |Ea| < 6 -> DESCRIPTIVE (carried to the pooled panel I + II analysis)
tests.L1b: Eb = discordant events; b = #(r_u hit, qlik_top1 miss), c = #(qlik_top1 hit, r_u miss); one-sided P(Binomial(b + c, 1/2) >= b); PASS iff |Eb| >= 6 and p < 0.05
tests.log_scores: LS_f(e) = (1/n_e) sum_a counts_e(a) log q_f(a), f in {base, lik, lik_raw, tail, assoc, uniform}; D_lik = LS_base - LS_lik, D_tail = LS_base - LS_tail; one-sided 95% percentile bootstrap lower bound (10,000 event resamples, numpy default_rng(20261021)); NON-INFERIOR iff LB > -0.10; two-sided CIs and the unit-clustered bootstrap beside
tests.pseudo_replication_guard: unit-level pooled landing (15-point rule) and unit-level L1a/L1b
tests.verdict: SUPPORTED-IN-PANEL iff L1a PASS and L1b PASS; DISCONFIRMED-IN-PANEL iff (mean D_lik <= 0 or mean D_tail <= 0 on E) and L1a p >= 0.05 with |Ea| >= 6; otherwise DESCRIPTIVE
tests.L2: correct S-labelled nudged programs whose algorithm has base valid == 0 and base correct == 0; rule-of-three bound 3/N if 0
tests.L3: events with >= 10 correct S programs: 10 random half-splits (seed 20261021 + i), one power gamma in 0:0.05:8 by ML on half A for q_base^g, q_tail^g, assoc^g; held-out log score on half B; Wilcoxon (descriptive); Kendall tau-b per unit between q_base and q_tail orders on S
tests.M: Spearman rho of each candidate with E_u over enrolled new units with a default; one-sided exact permutation p in the committed direction; Holm over 6 candidates; SUPPORTED iff rho >= 0.5 in the committed direction and Holm p < 0.05
tests.K: H5, P15, P20 of BINT, PN alpha 2 and PN alpha 4 on the full-simplex randomisation hull (exp27 hull_full.py), 2,000 bootstrap replicates with the maximum over settings inside each replicate; correct-only rarefied Hill-1 at depth 25; pass-rate cost with Newcombe CIs

replacement_class.definition: 1 if the base runner-up r_u is a library/one-line mode or the twin minority already contains r_u, else 0 (exp26 'replacement' coding: rank of r_u among the twin's non-default correct labels; 0 = absent)

runtime_merit.definition: log2(default median time / fastest correct non-default reference median time) on the unit's stress cases, 5 repeats

twin_modal_share.definition: share of the default among correct twin programs (300)
